newsitem.title: INDIA: SINGER INDIA 96/97 NET 43.4 MLN RUPEES.
newsitem.headline: SINGER INDIA 96/97 NET 43.4 MLN RUPEES.

text.p: Household appliance maker Singer India Ltd's net profit fell to 43.4 million rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 60.1 million in the previous year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Friday.
PTI said the company maintained its dividend at 30 percent in 1996/97.
Sales rose to 1.42 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 1.26 billion in the previous year, the news agency said.
"The competitive conditions in the consumer durable market put pressure on the company's margins," PTI quoted a company statement as saying.
The statement said sales of sewing machines and small appliances had registered only marginal growth. The increase in turnover was concentrated in refrigerators, washing machines and audio systems.
